description: Implementation of Local Bank funded Medirigiriya Water Supply  Project - Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-11-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, for the implementation of Medirigiriya Water Supply Project at a cost of Rs.1,363 million secured from local banks, was approved by the Cabinet.
